notes: The flagged three-morpheme unit `לְמָעְלָה` → *very* is genuinely indivisible: no English word is written for the preposition apart from the adverb, nor for the adverb apart from the directive `he`, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the head goes to the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rules 23, 32, 40).

`לֹא־הָיָה לְאֶלְעָזָר בָּנִים` → *Eliezer had no other sons*: the written `הָיָה` takes the *have*, the negation is recast onto the object nominal, and the possessive `לְ` is left `unrepresented` (rules 15, 40, 43).
